phase: frozen-network gate controls on the corrected source cohort
amendment_reason: Legacy timestamp provenance is unresolved. Complete the already requested fusion and acquisition-period comparisons on a physically traceable, full-export 4fps representation; selected from measurement provenance, not test performance.
ci: pointwise class-stratified paired-source bootstrap 95%; not simultaneous grid inference
difference_direction: learned minus control; negative delta Brier and positive delta AUROC favour learned allocation
frozen_clean_definition: retain each checkpoint's clean-input weights for the same held-out source recording; embeddings still respond to intervention
equal_definition: replace weights by 0.5/0.5 in the fitted RetinaFuse network; not the independently trained Equal-fusion model
joint_intervention: blend event-frame volume with its temporal mean and multiply standardized summary inputs by 1-strength
thinning_intervention: binomial thinning of event counts with the summary input unchanged
uncertainty_unit: unique source recording, not seed or checkpoint
checkpoint_aggregation: mean logits across final checkpoints within a seed, then mean probabilities across the three fixed seeds
additional_training: same frozen train.py, models and hyperparameters; missing full-native representation comparisons only
selection: fixed functional controls requested in the figure strategy; strengths are not selected by outer-test performance
interpretation: computational allocation and conditional effects; not physiological causation or universal reliability awareness
